title: Verify: Phaser effect context renders lighting effects with mocked scene
description: Unit tests with a fake Phaser scene.

steps.action: Build a fake scene with vi.fn() add.rectangle, add.circle, add.particles and scale {width:480,height:270}; each returned object has chainable setOrigin, setDepth, setBlendMode, setStrokeStyle and a destroy spy. Tests: for moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight, vignette specs with depth 400, assert setDepth(400) called and destroy() destroys all created objects (3 for vignette); for dust, assert add.particles called with key from a resolveKey stub returning 'dust-key'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/effectContext.test.ts
